title: Analytical Chemistry I
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an analytical method that is based upon the measurement of the weight of known composition."
Gravimetric analysis is an analytical method that is based upon the measurement of the weight of known composition.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a form of volumetric analysis in which the formation of a colored complex is used to indicate the end point of a titration."
Complexometric titration (sometimes chelatometry) is a form of volumetric analysis in which the formation of a colored complex is used to indicate the end point of a titration.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a reaction which involves the movement of electrons from one point to another, in a reaction between analyte and titrant."
Oxidation - Reduction reaction is a reaction which involves the movement of electrons from one point to another, in a reaction between analyte and titrant.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important measure in the quantitative analysis of data."
Variance is an important measure in the quantitative analysis of data.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the core and the most useful analytical procedures that make up quantitative techniques in analytical chemistry."
Titrimetric analysis (Titration) is one of the core and the most useful analytical procedures that make up quantitative techniques in analytical chemistry.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the degree of agreement between replicate measurements of the same quantity."
Precision is defined as the degree of agreement between replicate measurements of the same quantity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the substance(s) that tend to give up electron(s) and get oxidized to higher oxidation state."
Reducing agent is the substance(s) that tend to give up electron(s) and get oxidized to higher oxidation state.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called chelating agent, while the complex formed with metal ion is called chelate."
The ligand is called chelating agent, while the complex formed with metal ion is called chelate.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ligand species in complex formation, the complex formed are markedly affected by the pH."
Anion is the ligand species in complex formation, the complex formed are markedly affected by the pH.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a compound which changes when it binds to a metal ion."
A metal-ion indicator is a compound which changes when it binds to a metal ion.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a type of energy that is transmitted through space at enormous velocities."
Electromagnetic radiation is a type of energy that is transmitted through space at enormous velocities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very rapid and precise analytical quantitative method."
Volumetric titration is a very rapid and precise analytical quantitative method.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means EDTA not complexed to metal."
Free EDTA means EDTA not complexed to metal.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used as an indicator for halides at pH 7."
Fluorescien is used as an indicator for halides at pH 7.
fib: ______ are the two equivalence points while point B and D are the half- neutralization points whose values equal pKa2 as pK1 respectively.
Point C and E
Point C and E are the two equivalence points while point B and D are the half- neutralization points whose values equal pKa2 as pK1 respectively.
______ is a controllable and uncontrollable variation observed when comparing the measured values to the true value.
Error
Error is a controllable and uncontrollable variation observed when comparing the measured values to the true value.
______ is the most widely used chelator in the field of analytical chemistry, through direct titration or indirect sequence of reactions.
EDTA
EDTA is the most widely used chelator in the field of analytical chemistry, through direct titration or indirect sequence of reactions.
______ is a certain amount of energy, the unit of which is called photon.
Electromagnetic radiation process
Electromagnetic radiation process is a certain amount of energy, the unit of which is called photon.
______ is a fairly accurate and precise analytical method, if a proper indicator is selected.
Redox titration
Redox titration is a fairly accurate and precise analytical method, if a proper indicator is selected.
______ is one of the types of volumetric analyses.
Acid-base titration
Acid-base titration is one of the types of volumetric analyses.
______ is made up of electrolyte, electrodes and salt bridge. 3.2.3 Electrodes are strip of metals that are conducting in nature.
typical cell
A typical cell is made up of electrolyte, electrodes and salt bridge. 3.2.3 Electrodes are strip of metals that are conducting in nature.
______ is an equation which express pH of a buffer solution as a function of the concentration of the weak acid or base and the salt component of the buffer system.
Hasselbalch equation
Hasselbalch equation is an equation which express pH of a buffer solution as a function of the concentration of the weak acid or base and the salt component of the buffer system.
______ are used instead of moles and formula weight.
equivalent weight
Equivalent and equivalent weight are used instead of moles and formula weight.
______ is an analytical method which is used to determine larger number of metals that form soluble salt or slightly dissociated complexes.
Complexometric titration
Complexometric titration is an analytical method which is used to determine larger number of metals that form soluble salt or slightly dissociated complexes.
______ is an analytical technique that deals with reactions between measured volumes of a regent known as titrant against the test substance called analyte in a stochiometric manner.
Volumetric analysis
Volumetric analysis is an analytical technique that deals with reactions between measured volumes of a regent known as titrant against the test substance called analyte in a stochiometric manner.
______ is a term used for a substance that resists slight changes in pH of a system.
Buffer
Buffer is a term used for a substance that resists slight changes in pH of a system.
______ is a major concept required for volumetric calculation.
Molarity
Molarity is a major concept required for volumetric calculation.
